integrity: The proof separates analytic identities from computer-assisted algebraic elimination. The verifier reconstructs the critical identities and exact root counts from rational polynomials.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the continuous circle and the spectrum {0,1,4}; no finite-cyclic or other-spectrum formula is claimed. The algebraic optimizer is specified by an exact polynomial system plus a rational isolating interval rather than radicals.
title: Sharp eighth-moment norm at the first fourth-order resonance
